verdict.rationale: Close states that it includes pipeline management, and its API docs show that opportunities (deals) have a customizable status classed as active, won, or lost. Together these cover deal tracking with customizable stages. Nothing in the evidence describes a visual board view or drag-and-drop stage updates. missing for 10: evidence of a visual pipeline/kanban view, drag-and-drop stage changes, UI-level docs for configuring stages, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a founder, I can track deals on a visual pipeline with customizable stages and drag-and-drop updates

citations.quote: It combines calling, email, SMS, pipeline management, reporting, and an AI sales agent named Chloe into a single platform.
Opportunities have a customizable status (which always has a `status_type` of either `active`, `won`, or `lost`), and optionally can have a monetary amount
